signals.text: Recently added to Tolara — hiring trends need a week of history

bullets: Own the patient app and/or advocacy platform: what we build, in what order, and why.
Ship every day with engineering. Write the spec, cut the scope, unblock the work, check the result.
Spend real time with patients and Care Advocates, and turn what you see into product changes.
Pick the metrics that matter for your product, put them on a dashboard, and move them.
Work with operations, clinical and compliance so what we ship works for Medicare patients and holds up to CMS rules.
